criteria.criterion: P03-A through P03-G canonical complete / locks released
Threat model covers all FROZEN_G2 trust boundaries
Every HIGH/CRITICAL threat has downstream control ownership
Deny-by-default authorization and least privilege
Privileged MFA direction is phishing-resistant
Human Gate bound to exact action/resource/environment/digest/expiry
Raw production secrets prohibited from model/prompt/log/checkpoint surfaces
Execution credentials environment/account scoped; withdrawal/transfer forbidden where separable
Network location/VPN/geolocation is not authorization
Execution/secrets/recovery admin exposure fails closed; break-glass cannot bypass trading controls
Audit writers cannot mutate prior history and audit failure cannot convert deny to allow
Critical supply-chain findings/provenance/signature/digest failures block promotion
UNKNOWN execution requires reconciliation and forbids blind retry/reroute
Emergency access is scoped, time-bounded, audited and cannot bypass A5/A8 or enable Live
A5 Risk and A8 Security veto remain non-bypassable
Critical security/data/execution uncertainty fails closed
No planned runtime control falsely claimed implemented
Country/location is not an authorization/security architecture dependency
No unresolved Critical/High design or governance blocker
Production accounts/credentials/CANARY/LIVE/Auto Trading remain disabled/unprovisioned
